title: 临床样本的生物风险管理

points.K4: 成分复杂，按最高危险度对待
points.K5: 看采样单，防无症状携带
points.K6: 保存液也要查安全说明书
points.K8: 运输：包装、标签、吸收材料
points.K14: 血清学：离心在相应级别实验室
points.K15: 核酸提取：防离心气溶胶

shots.scene: 欣欣站在检验科样本接收台旁，手里拿着一个空白样本管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a sample reception counter holding a blank sample tube and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊：临床样本怎么管才安全。
overlay: 临床样本的生物风险管理

shots.scene: 阿杰从送样人手里接过一个保温运输箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student receives an insulated transport box from the security officer at the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 阿杰收到一箱医院送来的样本。

shots.scene: 阿杰正要直接在实验台上打开箱子，小研伸手拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is about to open the box on an open bench when the female graduate student raises a hand to stop him.
shots.narration: 他正要开箱，小研赶紧拦住。

shots.scene: 小研指着箱上的生物危害标志，阿杰挠头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the biohazard warning sign on the box while the young male student scratches his head.
shots.narration: 病人的样本，可不能随手拆。

shots.scene: 医院病房图标箭头指向实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a hospital ward icon to a laboratory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 临床样本，来自医院的病人。

shots.scene: 检验科和病理实验室两个房间图标
shots.prompt_en: Two room icons: a hospital clinical laboratory and a pathology laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 在检验科、病理实验室天天都要检测。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五个图标：试管、流程箭头、天平、盾牌、锁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five icons: a test tube, a process arrow, a balance scale, a shield and a padlock.
shots.narration: 这一课：认样本，懂流程，

shots.scene: 天平、盾牌、锁三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The balance, shield and padlock icons light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 评风险，定措施，管好安保。

shots.scene: 一排图标：血管、血清管、拭子
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a blood tube, a serum tube and a swab. No people.
shots.narration: 样本有很多种：血液、血清、拭子，

shots.scene: 一排图标：粪便盒、尿杯、体液瓶、组织块
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a stool container, a urine cup, a body fluid bottle and a small tissue piece in a jar. No people.
shots.narration: 还有粪便、尿液、体液和活检组织。

shots.section_title: 成分复杂，按最高危险度对待
shots.scene: 一支样本管里画着多种不同形状的小微生物
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube with many different tiny microbe shapes inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一份样本里，可能有好几种病原。
overlay: 成分复杂，按最高危险度对待

shots.section_title: 成分复杂，按最高危险度对待
shots.scene: 样本管上一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube with a large question mark over it. No people.
shots.narration: 到底有多危险，事先往往不知道。

shots.section_title: 成分复杂，按最高危险度对待
shots.scene: 问号变成最高等级的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: The question mark turns into the highest-level warning icon above the tube. No people.
shots.narration: 所以，按最高的危险度来对待。

shots.section_title: 成分复杂，按最高危险度对待
shots.scene: 小研戴手套、穿防护服，小心拿起样本管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and lab gown handles a sample tube very carefully.
shots.narration: 宁可多防一层，不可小看。

shots.section_title: 看采样单，防无症状携带
shots.scene: 小研拿起样本附带的空白采样单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the blank sample collection sheet attached to the tube.
shots.narration: 先看采样单，
overlay: 看采样单，防无症状携带

shots.section_title: 看采样单，防无症状携带
shots.scene: 采样单上病历图标和体温计图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank collection sheet with a medical record icon and a thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 了解病人的病史和现在的情况。

shots.section_title: 看采样单，防无症状携带
shots.scene: 一个看起来健康的人形图标，身上有隐藏的小病原
shots.prompt_en: A healthy-looking person pictogram with small hidden microbe dots inside. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：有的人带菌，却没有症状。

shots.section_title: 看采样单，防无症状携带
shots.scene: 样本管旁一个“不要轻视”的提醒图标
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube next to an exclamation mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看着正常的样本，也别掉以轻心。

shots.section_title: 保存液也要查安全说明书
shots.scene: 样本管泡在一瓶保存液里，瓶身有化学品象形图
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube sitting in a bottle of preservative liquid with a chemical hazard pictogram on it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的样本泡在化学保存液里。
overlay: 保存液也要查安全说明书

shots.section_title: 保存液也要查安全说明书
shots.scene: 小研翻开一份空白安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 这时要查随附的化学品安全说明书。

shots.section_title: 保存液也要查安全说明书
shots.scene: 生物危害标志和化学品象形图并排
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign next to a chemical hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险、化学风险，两头都要防。

shots.scene: 四个检测流程图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four process icons in a row: a culture plate, an antibody test plate, a DNA helix and a microscope. No people.
shots.narration: 临床样本的检测，主要有四类。

shots.scene: 稀释试管一排，再到平板长出菌落
shots.prompt_en: A row of dilution tubes leading to a culture plate with colonies. No people.
shots.narration: 一是分离培养：稀释，再接种培养。

shots.scene: 酶标板图标，抗原和抗体像钥匙和锁
shots.prompt_en: A multi-well test plate icon with antigen and antibody shapes fitting like a key in a lock. No people.
shots.narration: 二是血清学检测，看抗原抗体反应。

shots.scene: 核酸双螺旋图标和扩增仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon next to a thermal cycler icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三是提取核酸，再做扩增检测。

shots.scene: 显微镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A microscope icon with a glass slide. No people.
shots.narration: 四是显微镜检查。

shots.section_title: 运输：包装、标签、吸收材料
shots.scene: 样本从医院经运输车送到实验室的路线图
shots.prompt_en: A route map from a hospital icon via a delivery van icon to a laboratory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 样本要从医院送到实验室。
overlay: 运输：包装、标签、吸收材料

shots.section_title: 运输：包装、标签、吸收材料
shots.scene: 三层包装分解图：样本管、密封袋、硬质外箱
shots.prompt_en: An exploded diagram of three packaging layers: a sample tube, a sealed bag and a rigid outer box. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，包装要妥当，

shots.section_title: 运输：包装、标签、吸收材料
shots.scene: 外箱上贴着空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A rigid outer box with a blank label and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，标签要清楚，

shots.section_title: 运输：包装、标签、吸收材料
shots.scene: 样本管周围包着吸水垫，漏出的液体被吸住
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent pads wrapped around a sample tube soak up a small leak. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，包装里放吸收材料，防渗漏。

shots.scene: 运输箱里放着冰袋和干冰块图标
shots.prompt_en: An open transport box with ice packs and a dry ice block icon inside. No people.
shots.narration: 要配足冷却剂，保持样本完好。

shots.scene: 一堆碎冰融化渗水，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pile of crushed ice melting and leaking water out of a box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不推荐用碎冰，容易造成污染。

shots.scene: 王老师给负责送样的保卫处值班员讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator briefs the security officer, who delivers samples, next to a transport box.
shots.narration: 司机、快递员也要经过培训，

shots.scene: 值班员小心平放运输箱
shots.prompt_en: The security officer carefully places a transport box flat and upright in a van.
shots.narration: 知道箱里是什么，有什么风险。

shots.scene: 黄色底的生物危害标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 这是生物危害标志。

shots.scene: 样本盒、冰箱门上都贴着这个标志
shots.prompt_en: A sample box and a refrigerator door both carrying a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 样本、容器、冰箱上都常见到它。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前登记，同时在空白登记本上写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student logs a sample on a computer showing a blank form while writing in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 样本一到，就登记：电脑一份，手写一份。

shots.scene: 病人头像图标变成一串条码
shots.prompt_en: A patient silhouette icon turning into a barcode label on a tube. No people.
shots.narration: 用编号代替病人姓名，保护隐私。

shots.scene: 上锁的文件柜和带锁的服务器图标
shots.prompt_en: A locked filing cabinet next to a server icon with a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 纸质记录锁好，电子数据放安全服务器。

shots.scene: 冰箱里的样本盒，每格有空白编号
shots.prompt_en: Sample boxes in a freezer, each slot with a blank code label. No people.
shots.narration: 样本要存档，就要做好库存。

shots.scene: 培养箱里摆着平板
shots.prompt_en: Culture plates stacked inside an incubator. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌、病毒样本，可能要培养。

shots.scene: 纯培养物的平板旁边放着空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: A pure culture plate next to a blank risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 培养出的纯菌，按它的危险程度评估。

shots.scene: 芽孢和气溶胶飘散两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a spore shape and a cloud of tiny aerosol droplets drifting. No people.
shots.narration: 有的会形成芽孢，有的能经气溶胶传播，

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里操作平板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with culture plates inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 控制措施要选得恰当。

shots.section_title: 血清学：离心在相应级别实验室
shots.scene: 离心机图标，离心管里血清和血细胞分层
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge icon and a tube separated into serum on top and blood cells below. No people.
shots.narration: 血清学检测，常要离心分出血清。
overlay: 血清学：离心在相应级别实验室

shots.section_title: 血清学：离心在相应级别实验室
shots.scene: 实验室门上的二级、三级标识图标
shots.prompt_en: Two laboratory door icons marked with biosafety level pictograms, level two and level three. No people.
shots.narration: 要在二级或三级生物安全实验室做。

shots.section_title: 血清学：离心在相应级别实验室
shots.scene: 最高等级实验室的门图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door icon with the highest biosafety level pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 感染最高危险度病原的病人样本，

shots.section_title: 血清学：离心在相应级别实验室
shots.scene: 四级实验室剖面图，层层密封
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a maximum containment laboratory with several sealed layers. No people.
shots.narration: 可能要在四级设施里处理。

shots.section_title: 核酸提取：防离心气溶胶
shots.scene: 离心机盖子打开时冒出小飞沫
shots.prompt_en: Tiny droplets puffing out as a centrifuge lid is opened. No people.
shots.narration: 提取核酸也要离心，会产生气溶胶。
overlay: 核酸提取：防离心气溶胶

shots.section_title: 核酸提取：防离心气溶胶
shots.scene: 一台自动核酸提取仪，机身空白
shots.prompt_en: An automated nucleic acid extraction instrument with a plain blank casing. No people.
shots.narration: 用自动化提取仪，能减少气溶胶。

shots.section_title: 核酸提取：防离心气溶胶
shots.scene: 提取出的核酸管旁边一个小盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A tube of extracted nucleic acid next to a small green shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 提取出的核酸，本身风险很小。

shots.scene: 检测后的废物堆在一起，上面有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Used tubes, tips and swabs in a waste bin with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 检测产生的废物，一律按有害处理。

shots.scene: 废物袋贴空白标签，旁边登记本
shots.prompt_en: A sealed waste bag with a blank label next to a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 贴好标签，登记清楚。

shots.scene: 废物袋进高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: A waste bag going into an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能高压灭菌的，先灭菌。

shots.scene: 挥发性、腐蚀性两个化学品象形图，另走一条箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two chemical hazard pictograms for volatile and corrosive substances, with a separate arrow to a special container. No people.
shots.narration: 挥发、腐蚀性的，按专门方法处理。

shots.scene: 专用车辆图标驶向处置厂
shots.prompt_en: A closed waste transport truck icon driving to a treatment plant icon. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌后可焚烧，通常交专业公司处置。

shots.scene: 王老师翻看一叠空白报告单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a stack of blank report forms at her desk.
shots.narration: 安全做得好不好，怎么评？

shots.scene: 报告单图标旁一个上升的趋势箭头
shots.prompt_en: A report form icon with a trend arrow chart beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一看事件和事故报告，找规律。

shots.scene: 血清管图标和人员图标，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: A serum tube icon next to a person pictogram and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 二看人员的本底血清监测。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表，在一旁观察小研操作
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank checklist and quietly observes the female graduate student working.
shots.narration: 三是现场观察，审核操作。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，手里拿着空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator, holding a blank incident form.
shots.narration: 所有事件，都要报告生物安全员。

shots.scene: 空白事件表格，带编号格子
shots.prompt_en: A blank incident form with empty numbered boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 用专门表格记录，方便追溯。

shots.scene: 问题树图标，层层往下找到根
shots.prompt_en: A problem tree diagram drilling down from a symptom to a root at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 找出根本原因，

shots.scene: 规程卡上画修改的笔，版本号变化图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card being revised with a pen and a version arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 修改操作规程，不让它再发生。

shots.scene: 实验室里一个警示三角形图标，人员图标
shots.prompt_en: A large warning triangle icon above a laboratory and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故危及人员，也影响实验室运行。

shots.scene: 箭头从实验室指向管理层图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from a laboratory icon to a management office icon. No people.
shots.narration: 必须报告实验室管理层。

shots.scene: 管理层方框再指向一个主管部门图标
shots.prompt_en: The management box points on to a government office icon. No people.
shots.narration: 管理层再报告主管部门，以便调查。

shots.scene: 原因图标和控制措施图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A cause icon linked to a control measure shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 找原因，补措施，防止再发生。

shots.scene: 病人数据文件夹上一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A blank patient data folder with a padlock on it. No people.
shots.narration: 临床样本带着病人的个人信息。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白保密协议上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank confidentiality agreement.
shots.narration: 接触数据的人，要签保密协议。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上锁图标，文件柜上锁
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen with a padlock icon next to a locked cabinet of controlled documents. No people.
shots.narration: 电子数据加密，纸质文件受控保管。

shots.scene: 复印机和手机拍照图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a photocopier and a phone camera aimed at documents, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有书面授权，不得复制、拍照。

shots.scene: 超低温冰箱里一排排样本盒
shots.prompt_en: Rows of sample boxes inside an ultra-low temperature freezer. No people.
shots.narration: 样本可能要留着以后再分析。

shots.scene: 冰箱上的温度计图标和锁
shots.prompt_en: A freezer with a thermometer icon and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 按适当条件存放，保证实物安全。

shots.scene: 样本盒条码连到电脑里的空白清单
shots.prompt_en: A barcode on a sample box linked by a line to a blank inventory list on a screen. No people.
shots.narration: 库存清楚，每一管都能追溯。

shots.scene: 王老师把几本空白法规书放在桌上
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator places several blank law books on the desk.
shots.narration: 各单位要遵守本国和地方的法规。

shots.scene: 法规书旁一本空白生物安全手册
shots.prompt_en: A blank biosafety manual next to the law books. No people.
shots.narration: 据此编写本单位的生物安全手册。

shots.scene: 国际标准图标作为背景，前面是法规书
shots.prompt_en: A faint globe document icon in the background with the law books in front. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以参考国际生物风险管理标准。

shots.scene: 王老师、小研、阿杰一起讨论空白的操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank procedure document.
shots.narration: 结合本单位的实际，

shots.scene: 规程文件上盖上一个对勾印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure document receiving a green check stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 制定具体的生物风险管理程序。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现采样单、生物危害标志、三层包装三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a collection sheet, a biohazard warning sign and three-layer packaging.
shots.narration: 按最高危险度对待，看采样单。

shots.scene: 三层包装、冰袋、离心机、废物袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of three-layer packaging, an ice pack, a centrifuge and a waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 包装运输做好，废物先灭菌。

shots.scene: 报告单、锁、条码图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a report form, a padlock and a barcode. No people.
shots.narration: 事件要报告，数据要保密，样本可追溯。

shots.scene: 法规书和生物安全手册图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of law books and a blank biosafety manual. No people.
shots.narration: 守法规，按本单位定程序。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着贴好标签的运输箱，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a neatly labeled transport box and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 管好每一份样本，我们下次见！
